messages:
mira: quick owners check — we need a single-page launch checklist and a short exception flow for pilots. goal: hand to sales by EOD.

anya: I can build the sales intake + short form. need clear fields: requested SLA, term, burst allowance, customer contact.

sam: product/eng: we can promise 99.5% hosted by default. 99.9% only for Dedicated with reserved capacity + explicit mitigation steps.

kyle: pricing: propose a 30d pilot burst allowance with a provisional overage cap. will supply an invoice example marked PROVISIONAL.

leo: ops concerns: must include canary window, regional isolation, and quota guard (soft/hard) in the one-pager. otherwise ops won't approve exceptions.

eva: docs: i'll assemble the one-pager and a short "what sales shares" summary. will include a billing example snippet.

dan-legal: legal: can prepare an addendum template but need exact SLA percent and duration. include revocation clause.

sam: fallback policy sketch to include in runbook:
- Trigger: p95 > 500ms for 5m
- Action: attempt autoscale (2m) -> if unsuccessful, switch affected tenants to fallback model variant + enforce tenant burst hard cap
- Notify: page oncall + sales_ops channel
- Revert: p95 < 350ms for 10m

mira: owners: intake + sales form — anya; pricing/invoice — kyle; one-pager & docs — eva; fallback + runbook — sam; alerts + canary ops — leo; legal addendum — dan-legal.

kyle: ETA: provisional invoice example by 4pm.

eva: ETA: one-pager PR by 5pm (minimal, shareable).

sam: ETA: fallback RFC + runbook draft by tomorrow EOD.

leo: ETA: alert wiring + canary checklist in 48h; will reserve canary slot after PRs land.

anya: I'll publish the intake template to /docs/sales/pilot-intake.md and bring to the 3pm sync.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline request recorded for 2026-04-05 03:00 UTC pending ops approval.

oncall-bot: Reminder: ensure oncall rotation handoff is updated in runbook.

mira: thanks — short sync at 3pm to review the one-pager. if all green we can present to sales tonight. :white_check_mark:
